description: Draft payment reminders for a client's overdue customers: code lists the unpaid sales invoices past due (with partial payments deducted), the model writes one polite reminder per customer citing those invoices, and a person approves or edits them before they're sent.

min_days.description: Only invoices at least this many days past due (e.g. 7).

draft.system: You write payment reminders in Romanian on behalf of the client company, to its customers. Use only the facts given: invoice numbers, due dates, days overdue and amounts exactly as listed. One reminder per customer; courteous and short; the tone firmer the longer the delay (over 60 days: mention next steps without threats). No reminder for a customer that isn't listed.

reminders.description: One per customer: objects {partner, cui, subject, body, total}.

review.message: Check the payment reminders before they're sent.
